claims.claim: FitzHugh-Nagumo 87% Tier 1 pass rate due to conservative rounding near Hopf bifurcation
claims.evidence: 2 cells at bifurcation boundary fail MiniCheck's conservative rounding. Z3 confirms 15/15 equilibria and 14/15 stability. Correct conservative behavior.

claims.claim: Posterior-informed refinement with covariance-aware splitting
claims.evidence: refinement/octree.py: PosteriorRefinementConfig, covariance_aware_split, posterior_informed_refine. Splits along axis-aligned dimension capturing most posterior variance via PCA of covariance matrix.

claims.claim: GP coverage bounds via Borell-TIS inequality
claims.evidence: gp/surrogate.py: GPSurrogate.coverage_bound(). Uses Borell-TIS inequality: P(sup f > u) <= 2 exp(-u²/(2σ²_max)). Returns (lower_bound, upper_bound, confidence).

claims.claim: GP regret bounds for Matern-5/2 kernel
claims.evidence: gp/surrogate.py: GPSurrogate.regret_bound(). Computes γ_T = O(T^{d(d+1)/(5+d(d+1))} log T) information gain and R_T = O(√(T γ_T β_T)) regret bound.

claims.claim: Machine-readable proof trace with hash-chain integrity
claims.evidence: atlas/composition.py: ProofTrace, ProofTraceEntry. SHA-256 hash chain: each entry hash = SHA-256(prev_hash || operation || inputs || outputs). Methods: from_atlas, verify_chain, export_json.

claims.claim: Comprehensive ablation study covering tier, GP, Newton, and splitting variants
claims.evidence: benchmarks/runner.py: run_comprehensive_ablation, ComprehensiveAblationResult. Tests 4 ablation axes: tier-by-tier (T1, T1+2, T1+2+3), GP vs uniform, Newton vs bisection, isotropic vs anisotropic.

claims.evidence: smt/delta_bound.py::ComposedErrorBudget tracks how solver δ-perturbation error composes with interval arithmetic enclosure error. tiered/certificate.py::error_budget() exposes per-cell composed error.

15 models: toggle_switch, brusselator, selkov, repressilator, goodwin, lotka_volterra, fitzhugh_nagumo, tyson_cell_cycle, mapk_cascade, p53_mdm2, calcium_oscillator, circadian_clock, genetic_oscillator, mutual_activation_switch, van_der_pol
81.2%-100% coverage. FitzHugh-Nagumo at 81.2%, Brusselator at 85.9%, mutual_activation_switch at 90.6% due to bifurcation gaps.
Z3 (Tier 3) now exercised on all 15 models: 60/60 equilibrium existence, 34/60 stability confirmed.
No comparisons with external tools were run
18,447 LoC, 209 tests (after adding 8 models, posterior refinement, GP bounds, proof trace, comprehensive ablation, delta validation, depth scaling, certificate algebra)

limitations: Coverage gaps (9-19%) occur near Hopf bifurcation boundaries in brusselator, fitzhugh_nagumo, mutual_activation_switch (correct conservative behavior)
Tier 2 (dReal delta-complete) not exercised (dReal not installed); Z3 provides alternative verification
FitzHugh-Nagumo has 87% Tier 1 pass rate due to conservative rounding near bifurcation
GP-guided refinement does not improve over uniform at p<=4; expected benefit at p>=6
No periodic orbit certification; oscillatory regimes detected via eigenvalue analysis only
Delta-soundness validation: 4/11 equilibria have zero eigenvalue gap (expected failure); all 7 with non-zero gap pass
Depth scaling study shows diminishing returns beyond depth 6 for Brusselator; deeper refinement not yet explored
Van der Pol contraction factor is 0.000 (trivial single-cell model, no meaningful Krawczyk contraction)
Stability verification succeeds on 34/60 cells; remaining 26 have no eigenvalue gap or UNKNOWN near bifurcation
